podcast.title: Licensed Air Transport Pilot and Instructor (1996)
podcast.body: Dexter Holland obtained his pilot's license in 1996 and is now a licensed air transport pilot and flight instructor. In November 2004, he completed a solo circumnavigation of the world in his twin-engine Cessna Citation, covering 25,000 miles in 10 days while subsisting solely on Doritos and beef jerky. He later faced financial issues with his aircraft, including a 2014 lawsuit from Cessna for nearly $1 million in arrears and the repossession of two planes, problems resolved by The Offspring's $50 million publishing catalog sale in 2016. "In November 2004 he flew his own twin-engine sesna citation around the world. 25,000 miles in 10 days, totally solo."

podcast.title: Financial Troubles and Publishing Catalog Sale
podcast.body: Dexter Holland encountered significant financial difficulties related to his aircraft, including being sued by Cessna in 2014 for nearly $1 million in arrears on his jet payments, leading to the repossession of two other planes. His payment structure was eventually renegotiated to 71 monthly payments of around $10,000 each, plus a final payment of approximately $500,000. In early 2016, The Offspring sold a substantial portion of their publishing catalog for $50 million, which likely resolved his plane-related financial issues. "In 2014 he was sued by sesna for missing payments on his jet after falling nearly $1 million in a rears."

xref.title: Anarchy Airlines – Dexter Holland's Private Jet Fleet, Solo Round-the-World Flight 2004
xref.body: *Smash* (1994) and subsequent Offspring albums generating more than 32 million in worldwide sales gave singer Dexter Holland the means to pursue his passion for aviation. He earned his first pilot's license in 1996, subsequently gaining more advanced certifications. He owns a Citation II twin-engine jet (approximately $2.5 million used), painted with the anarchy symbol on the tailfin and furnished with leopard-print interior — his own "Anarchy Airlines." He also flies an Aero Vodochody L-39 Czech/Russian jet fighter. He has enough simulator hours to pilot a 747. On November 25, 2004, Holland completed a secret solo circumnavigation: Los Angeles, New York, Iceland, Egypt, Dubai, Bangkok, Siberia, Russia, Alaska, and home — 11 days sustained almost entirely on beef jerky and Doritos, during which he encountered a volcanic eruption in Iceland, locusts in Egypt, and uncooperative customs officials in Russia. "Some people are into golf. Some people are into shooting deer. I'm into flying."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Publishing Catalog Sale (2016)
xref.body: In early 2016, The Offspring sold a portion of their publishing catalog for $50 million. This significant financial transaction helped their frontman, Dexter Holland, resolve outstanding payment issues with Cessna related to his private jets, which had led to a lawsuit and repossessions. "Then in early 2016 the offspring sold a chunk of their publishing catalog for $50 million which should clear up the plane problems."

xref.title: Aviation Achievements and Financial Challenges
xref.body: Dexter Holland is rated to fly executive jets, having obtained his pilot's license in 1996. In late 2004, he fulfilled a long-held ambition by flying solo around the world in a twin-engine Cessna Citation, covering 25,000 miles in 10 days while subsisting on Doritos and beef jerky. Although he once owned three planes, two were repossessed, and he faced a lawsuit over payment arrears for another. He resolved these debts by selling off some of The Offspring's publishing money, allowing him to fly freely again. "So in late 2004, he did it. He took a twin engine set-na citation, solo around the world. 25,000 miles and 10 days existing on, he says, Doritos and Beef jerky."

xref.title: Dexter Holland's Aviation Career and Plane Ownership
xref.body: Dexter Holland is a certified jet pilot who has successfully flown solo around the world. He possesses a collection of three aircraft, which includes Cessna corporate jets and a retired Soviet-era fighter plane that he acquired from Estonia. He has accumulated sufficient flight hours in jets to be qualified to pilot a 747. "Dexter is a certified jet pilot who has flown solo around the world."

xref.title: Dexter Holland's Hot Sauce Business – Gringo Bendito
xref.body: Dexter Holland, the singer for The Offspring, owns a hot sauce company called Gringo Bendito. The company manufactures its hot sauce in Newport Beach, California, producing approximately 120 gallons per week. It has expanded its distribution to grocery store chains and is served in several restaurants in Orange County. The brand's logo features Dexter dressed as a Mexican bandit. "If you've ever heard of Gringo Bendito, this is a brand of hot sauce. Dexter owns the company."

xref.title: PhD in Microbiology and HIV Research
xref.body: Dexter Holland holds a PhD in microbiology, which explains extended periods between The Offspring's albums. His 2017 thesis focused on HIV research and was titled "Discovery of mature microRNA sequences within the protein coding regions of global HIV-1 genomes, predictions of novel mechanisms for viral infection and pathogenicity." "So you want to know why the offspring went so long between albums? There you go. He was working as PhD."
